sound-setup.note: Rebased on the accepted Raphael baseline after the user identified the still-Japanese first BGM title. The coordinated layer translates all 38 packed BGM titles, remaps their interior pointers, and translates all 57 SFX titles. Experimental pending a complete scroll/playback cold-boot test.

natural-dialogue-probe.note: A source-reviewed, naturally edited Raphael opening through the tutorial choice, using dialogue-fixed-v1 and the live-tested raphael-story-live profile without changing record sizes or ILNK offsets. Cold-boot testing disproved the bare-0A experiment: protected 0A 20 breaks are mandatory in this progressive renderer. Route-aware FI/FA/FO widths prevent the generic macro estimate from forcing premature wraps. The failed descender-font experiment is deliberately excluded.

raphael-b44-long-dialogue-poc.note: REVOKED: cold-boot testing rendered the first expanded record, then skipped the remaining scene and entered town. The relocation map is deliberately marked incomplete so the builder hard-fails. Block 44 has unresolved interior VM continuation/event references; outer ILNK offsets and NUL-segment preservation are not sufficient.

raphael-b44-parity-relocation-probe.note: Second five-record relocation probe. Runtime comparison proved that changing record parity moved the following 00 40 FF FF command prefix off the CS VM's expected 16-bit phase. This profile preserves every source record's odd/even byte length and remains experimental until cold-boot progression is confirmed.

raphael-full-natural-v2-parity-opening.note: Full reviewed Raphael v2 route plus the cold-boot-passed parity-preserving five-record opening expansion. The relocation batch explicitly overrides the same five compressed fixed records; all remaining build-safe route records retain exact allocation and pair-phase formatting. Still experimental pending a new cold-boot route test.

raphael-full-natural-v2.note: All 331 currently identified Raphael records are accounted for by source-first natural-dialogue-v2 work. Only records with mapped control state and fixed-size audit clearance enter the ROM; explicit blocked drafts remain non-buildable metadata. The profile includes the user's cold-boot-passed cave-free zero-cursor ARM9 rewrite, pair-phase-aware protected-break encoding, and a fail-closed check against exact-width first rows that would double-advance. It remains experimental until a new cold-boot route test passes.

raphael-intro-lisbon-natural-relocation.note: REVOKED after cold-boot failure: expanding the two choice slots moved the second option into the first string and displaced the guided-tutorial branch entry, producing two blank prompts. The generated batch has since been narrowed and must be used only through the replacement choicefix profile.

raphael-intro-lisbon-choicefix.note: Accepted and baked into the 2026-08-20 canonical baseline after explicit user approval. Relocates 106 prose records, preserves the choice parser's proven 8-byte and 14-byte slots with centered wording, and removes the stored newline that dropped the first glyph in the shared crew-join notice.

raphael-tutorial-trader.note: Extends the guided Lisbon tutorial through shared Trader, tavern, and sailor-recruitment dialogue; preserves every proven interior entry offset in packed Trader prompts; and replaces the unsafe two-line market-report fee label with a single-line placeholder-preserving caption. Packed tavern/recruitment variants without proven entry offsets remain explicitly blocked. Experimental until cold-boot tested through the guided Lisbon lesson.

hodram-sc2-control-map-probe.note: REVOKED after route-identification correction: SC2 block 27 is a Lil-route scene where Hodram appears as an NPC, not Hodram's playable opening. The ROM loaded but could not provide an accessible New Game test path.

hodram-intro-english-probe.note: Experimental natural-English Hodram opening in the correct SC1 file: 67 fixed-allocation records across blocks 42-44, from the opening fleet exercise and speech through the strategic tutorial and first Lil/Kamil encounter. Uses guarded pair-phase formatting and awaits cold-boot portrait, macro, wrap, and progression testing.

hodram-stockholm-tavern-complete.note: Experimental integrated Hodram candidate covering the accepted opening probe, the complete first Stockholm tavern/dock/trading-post tutorials, Gerhard's omitted surname slot, safe shared tavern greetings and recruitment prompts, and exact-offset repairs for the screenshot-reported packed tavern price, hostess, rumor, and introduction records. Awaits a full cold-boot route and building test.

hodram-trading-complete.note: Experimental Hodram trading-system pass layered on the first-Stockholm candidate. It preserves the runtime-proven prefixes and packed entry points for Trader and tavern dialogue, terminates every exact-width commodity label, repairs Lubeck's port/region/faction fields and market buttons, fixes the market-report fee caption, and redraws the four cramped town-information plaques at a readable size.
